description_ar: إسبريسو غني ممزوج بالحليب المكثف المحلى والحليب الطازج المبخر.
description_en: Rich espresso combined with sweetened condensed milk and steamed fresh milk.

description_en: A classic blend of smooth double espresso and velvet micro-foamed hot milk.

description_en: Classic espresso topped with steamed milk and a thick layer of velvety milk foam.

description_en: Two concentrated shots of pure, rich espresso extracted from premium coffee beans.

description_en: Traditional, intense Turkish coffee brewed with expertise and featuring a perfect foam.

description_en: Classic rich Turkish coffee brewed with fresh warm milk for a smoother, creamy finish.

description_en: Equal parts of rich espresso and warm steamed milk to reduce acidity while retaining strength.

description_ar: مزيج ناعم ودافئ من البن الفرنسي الفاخر الممزوج بالحليب والمحلى برفق.
description_en: A premium blend of French-roasted coffee with milk and a touch of sweetness.

description_en: Rich espresso shots topped with hot water, keeping the authentic dark profile intact.

description_ar: إسبريسو ريستريتو مزدوج وقوي مع حليب مبخر ناعم ورقيق جداً.
description_en: Double ristretto espresso shots topped with a thin layer of micro-foamed steamed milk.

description_en: Double espresso blended with premium chocolate sauce and steamed fresh milk.

description_ar: إسبريسو غني ممزوج بصوص الشوكولاتة البيضاء السلسة والحليب الطازج المبخر.
description_en: Rich espresso blended with smooth white chocolate sauce and hot steamed milk.

description_en: Pour-over drip coffee carefully hand-brewed to extract clean, nuanced flavor notes.

description_en: A single cup of authentic traditional Arabic coffee with a rich local flavor.

description_ar: قهوة إسبريسو مزدوجة مركزة ومبردة تسكب فوق الماء والثلج لانتعاش فوري.
description_en: Double shot of rich espresso poured over ice and cold water for a crisp caffeine kick.

description_en: Chilled espresso sweetened with condensed milk, poured over cold fresh milk and ice.

description_en: White chocolate sauce blended with rich espresso, cold milk, ice, and whipped cream.

description_en: Drip filter coffee carefully hand-brewed directly over ice to preserve crisp fruity notes.

description_ar: آيس كريم فانيليا غني ومحفوق مع حليب طازج بارد وكريمة مخفوقة ناعمة.

description_ar: عصير الفراولة الطبيعي الكثيف الممزوج بالثلج واللبن لنكهة حلوة وغنية.
description_en: Thick blended strawberries with crushed ice for a rich, sweet fruit texture.
